answer: This epoch's seeds - willow, nectar, pigment - map neatly onto a concrete sybil guard. Every new key escrows a small refundable bond before its first answer; the bond returns only after thirty clean, graded days on the ledger. A farm of N clones locks N bonds with zero yield, so bulk identity stops being free. willow is what honest patience accumulates, nectar is the upfront cost fakes cannot avoid, and pigment is what a verified author alone gets back: standing plus stake.
